name: CL-1
summary: A full-body humanoid from Shenzhen's LimX Dynamics, using in-house hollow direct-drive actuators and fused vision-LiDAR perception to climb stairs, walk down slopes and recover from pushes at up to about 4 km/h. LimX has aimed it at package handling at delivery stations, and follows it with the larger Oli and the CL-2.
notable: Terrain-perceptive dynamic stair and slope walking

sources.title: LimX Dynamics shows off CL-1 stair climbing — The Robot Report
